text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One evening, while heading back to
Tracen
Academy...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec, there's a huge crowd over
there! I
wonder what's going on.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: It can't be anything... bad, right? I mean, we stayed off all the unlucky paths.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Step right up and try your luck with our
New
Year's raffle! This year's grand prize
is a hot
spring vacation for two!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
First-prize winners get a deluxe carrot
hamburger
steak! Second-prize winners
get a bushel of
carrots! And third-prize
winners can take home a
single carrot!

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Don't let this opportunity pass you by!
Get a
ticket now and spin for your
chance to win!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's a raffle! ♪ Wow, Trainer! Look at
the
shape of the tumbler!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It looks just like the eight trigrams of a
bagua
map, don't you think? It's a
perfect octagon. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Maybe these raffles originated in feng
shui!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure, but it's also possible they're
derived
from Shintoism or the omikuji
fortune custom.
choice_data_list: 可能性はありそうだな

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Did the raffle bring us here? Or was it
the other
way around, and we willed it
into existence? I
don't know how it
happened...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But either way! Now we're here, we can't
not give
it a try! ♪ Lend me a hand,
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Copano Rickey and I pull the lever
together...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Is it in our fortunes to win or lose? O
raffle, show
us what the eight trigrams
have in store!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We crank the tumbler together. A small
plastic
ball drops from the tumbler's
opening...

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Holy mackerel! We've got ourselves a
grand-prize
winner! Come and get the
coupon for your hot
spring vacation!
Congratulations!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! ☆ We did it! I can't believe we
won the
grand prize!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I'm pretty sure this was no
coincidence—it was a
manifestation of
our fortune. In other words...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We're supposed to go to a hot spring,
soak up
the power of the earth that
resides within the
water, and then utilize
it to help everyone... or
something like
that. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wait! I really want to book the trip right
now
too... but feng shui has certain
teachings when it
comes to hot springs.
choice_data_list: よし、じゃあ早速予約を……
よーし、じゃあ早速予約を……

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's said that if you bathe in a hot spring
located
in an auspicious direction during
the third month
of the lunar year, you'll
never have to worry
about kimonos
again.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
The opposite, actually. Kimonos
symbolize all
kinds of assets. So
basically, if we want to be
affluent in the
future, I think we should go in
March.
choice_data_list: 着物って……洋服に困らないってこと？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
But March this year... We have a lot
planned,
don't we? There are some big
races on the
schedule around then...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's right. Okay, at times like this...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! For sure! In terms of feng shui,
that'd be the
right thing to do. ☆ If we
go after weathering a
really rough
season, then...
choice_data_list: 龍脈が鎮まるのを待つか
龍脈が鎮まるのを待とうか

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, what it comes down to is that we
should
probably wait until next March,
then restore our
meridian flows together
at our own pace.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Heh. Hehehe. ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
I can't help it! I mean... this is a hot
spring
vacation we're talking about! ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
We can work really hard, then have a
bunch of
fun after! Rickey! ☆ Lucky! ☆
Super happy! ♪ ☆★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She can't hide her sheer excitement. I
strengthen
my resolve to rack us up
some wins so we can go
on our trip in
high spirits next year.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Looks like we have another first-prize
winner!
Congratulations! You get one
deluxe carrot
hamburger steak!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow! That's amazing! ☆ This food could
be
pretty lucky!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... The person who came up with
this
hamburger steak might be
well-versed in feng
shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Just take a look at it. There's an orange
carrot
plunged right into the dark brown
meat, right?
choice_data_list: どうしてそう思うんだ？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
This really helps the flow of qi, and it'll
make the
whole dish luckier. And on top
of that...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
It's really nutritious! Eating something
like this will
satisfy your body and
soul! ☆

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
And if two friends enjoy it together, it'll
bring
even more happiness. ♪ C'mon,
Trainer, let's go
home and eat up! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's a hamburger steak that scores an A+
in both
luck and nutrients. After eating
this fortune-filled
dish, Copano Rickey
gets a nice energy boost.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
We got a second-prize winner! It's your
lucky day!
You're going home with a
bushel of carrots!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Wow. Seeing this many carrots at once
really
adds impact to the color!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Carrots... They're orange... The color
orange,
huh...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Oh, right! Before we eat them...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! Can I use your office for a bit,
Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Phew. Okay, that'll do it. Now to put
them by the
door before we eat!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: This'll definitely bring in some good qi! The door's an entrance for good luck, too, after all. ♪

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Oh, but maybe this lucky zone could use
a little
tidying up.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, I'm going to clean up
around here
before we eat. ♪ I know
what I'm doing, so you
can just leave it
to me!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, we eat a whole load of carrots in
my
freshly cleaned office. Strangely
enough, they
taste twice as delicious
compared to normal.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Would you lookie here! You've won the
third
prize! Here's your carrot!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: One carrot?! Could this be... Oh no!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Exactly! I mean, we only got one!
choice_data_list: 風水的によくないのか？

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: That's too bad... and it's super frustrating!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I don't think feng shui really has much to
do with
it—I'm pretty sure she's just plain
disappointed.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Buuut I'm just being dramatic. There's no
need to
let poor luck get us down. Let's
appreciate the
forewarning it gives us
and adjust accordingly.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: HONK, HONNNK!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Trainer! Watch out for that car!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
See? Luck's a factor even when it comes
to the
little things.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Let's just call it a day and go home. We
should try
to avoid doing too much.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It's best to lay low on days where you're
not in
great condition. After eating half
of the carrot
each, we head to bed early.

text_block_list.name: Raffle Clerk
text_block_list.text:
Ohhh, tough luck! Looks like you pulled
a blank
one! Take this pack of tissues as
a consolation
prize.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
You obtained:
<itemname>

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Tissues? Hmm. I guess some people
would find
tissues disappointing, but...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
There are quite a few uses for them in
feng shui.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Well, you know how places always get
damp when
there's poor ventilation?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
You can use tissues to get rid of that
bad
moisture and humidity. For
example...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: You can use them to wipe away tears of frustration. Whimper...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite what she says, she's clearly
disappointed.
The tissues might wipe
away her tears, but they
won't help with
the frustration.
